hook: Sony Music Entertainment promised a 1.5% royalty rate, then paid only 0.75%.

sections.voiceover: Sony Music Entertainment promised a 1.5% royalty rate, then paid only 0.75%.
On October 16, 2026, Ishmael Sadiq Montague sued Sony Music Entertainment in New York. Missing royalties stem from the Chris Brown track Party. Where did that missing 0.75% royalty share go?

text_overlay.text: Filing in New York Federal Court

sections.voiceover: Except Sony Music Entertainment allegedly stalled a rights deal with Xposure Music.
The producer claims the company withheld half his agreed payout. That delay blocked a royalty deal involving Xposure Music. Court filings show he now demands $1,247,500 in damages.
The lawsuit seeks at least $1,247,500 from Sony Music Entertainment.
